page_title: RAY 0-4 ESP | Rayo Vallecano v Espanyol 04/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Alejandro Hernandez has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Pere Milla (Espanyol) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
90+3' Corner kicks – 8:4.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' 0 - 4 Pere Milla (Espanyol) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the right side of the goal.
87' Pere Milla (Espanyol) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
87' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
85' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Pathe Ciss will be replaced by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano).
83' Roberto Fernandez Jaen comes off the pitch to be replaced by Pere Milla (Espanyol).
83' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) replacing Exposito.
83' A substitution has been made. Javi Puado is replaced by Jofre (Espanyol).
81' What a great effort! Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches over the crossbar. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
78' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 8:4.
75' Inigo Perez has decided to substitute Unai Lopez and he is replaced by Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano).
75' Here's the change. Pep Chavarria leaves the pitch and Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as a substitute.
74' Exposito (Espanyol) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
72' 0 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Javi Puado (Espanyol) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Augusto Batalla no chance!
72' Javi Puado (Espanyol) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
70' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
70' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Espanyol!

69' Play continues despite the shouts by some Espanyol players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Alejandro Hernandez interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
68' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar.
66' Total attempts – 13:11.
64' Substitution. Pol Lozano did his best and is replaced by Alex Kral (Espanyol).
62' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
59' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
56' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Antoniu Roca is replaced by Fernando Calero (Espanyol).
55' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
54' The ball possession is 65:35.
52' The ball goes out of play and Espanyol have been awarded a corner kick.
52' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
52' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano). It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.
49' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
49' The attendance is 11905.
49' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
46' Half-time substitution. Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) will not participate anymore and Isi Palazon is coming on.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Inigo Perez probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Aridane Hernandez (Rayo Vallecano). He is replaced by Pacha.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Espanyol take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
41' Chance! Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
39' 4:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
37' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
35' Espanyol failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

35' Javi Puado (Espanyol) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the right side of the goal. Augusto Batalla is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
33' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
33' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
32' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.

30' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant.
28' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
26' Augusto Batalla displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
23' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 64:36.
21' Exposito (Espanyol) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
19' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
19' Rayo Vallecano fail to score from a corner as Joan Garcia (Espanyol) leaps to collect the ball.
18' Javi Puado (Espanyol) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the right post.
16' 0 - 2 Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the bottom right corner.
14' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

12' 0 - 1 Goal! Exposito sent a fine cross from the corner kick. The perfect pass found Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) and his bullet header from around the penalty spot went straight into the left side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
12' The referee awards a corner and Exposito (Espanyol) goes over to take it.
10' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Close! Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
6' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
4' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Rayo Vallecano will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Alejandro Hernandez.
